one_month_reasoning: Inside the window: Q1 FY27 results Wed 2026-11-04 after the close (guide revenue 2.2-2.4B, non-GAAP EPS 1.85-2.05; Street 1.97 / 2.30B; Earnings Whispers whisper 2.05) and the Dec-quarter guide (Street ~2.53B per TIKR); annual meeting 2026-11-18. COHR has landed above every re-opened guide midpoint (revenue +2.0-3.4%, EPS +2.2-7.5%) and our model has 2.37B / 2.07, so a beat is likely, but the last two beats were sold (Aug: +9% after hours then -8% next day) and the stock reacts to the forward guide, cash burn and CPO commentary more than to the quarter. Positioning is less crowded after a 52% drawdown: short interest fell 18% to 4.6% of float (MarketBeat 10-15) and hedge-fund holders fell 114 -> 105 in Q2. I centre the distribution +1% above spot (beat record, de-rated multiple, falling short interest) with a 23.5% one-month lognormal sigma (89% realized vol / ~3.8, slightly below the brief's annual/3.5 because realized vol includes the October rate shock), so P(>= spot) = 0.52.

Incremental D&C margin Q4->Q1 33% (Q3->Q4 23%, Q2->Q3 27%): 6-inch InP yields and opex leverage (10-K: GM up on cycle time and yield gains). Q2-Q4 FY27 26.8/27.0/27.2%; FY28-29 27.5% (held: Sherman ramp costs and price-downs on 800G as 1.6T ramps offset leverage). Variant: flat at FY26 25.2% = -1.7pt on the FY27 average 26.9%, -$0.62 FY27 EPS (-6.3%). agent_4: FY28 27.25%, FY29 27.0% (set 27.5%): cnyes expert expects 1.6T SiPh DR at ~$800-900 in 2027 and new module entrants late 2027; Innolight warns supply catch-up brings price pressure; offset by 6-inch InP (4x devices at about half the cost per device, PhotonCap). Effect about -1% on horizon EPS.

D&C quarters: Q1 FY27 1,935 = our company revenue 2,370 (guide midpoint 2,300 x 1.03, see guidance_check) less Industrial 435 (+19.8% q/q; Q2-Q4 FY26 q/q were +10.8%, +12.7%, +18.6%). Variant: supply-unconstrained ramp (Q2-Q4 FY27 +15%/qtr) gives FY27 ~9.6B (+6%); downside a 2-quarter digestion pause in FY28 (flat q/q) ~-12% FY28 D&C.

downside.story: P10: LightCounting's 'bumpy ride' correction arrives in CY2027-28 (it already calls the supply chain 'clearly overreacting' and assumes only +50% capex in 2027) while new module capacity (Innolight, Eoptolink, later Luxshare/Dongshan) and CPO/NPO pilots cut pluggable pricing: D&C capture -25% (FY28 D&C ~9.0B instead of 12.0B), D&C margin -3pt (back to ~24%, below FY26 25.2% on under-absorbed 6-inch InP capacity), Industrial -10% and -2pt on a semicap turn; the P/E de-rates 6 turns to 14x as the market prices a cyclical peak and the cash burn (FY26 FCF -1.02B, five OCF misses) persists. Marvell bundle takes COHR transceiver share (appraisal low variant).

base.story: Median: capacity-bound D&C growth of ~72% in FY27 and ~32% in FY28 as InP output doubles by Dec-26 and again by end-2027, D&C margin ~27%, Industrial flat-to-up, >$3B quarterly revenue reached in Q4 FY27; FCF turns positive in FY28; the market keeps most of COHR's discount to optics peers (20x NTM).

upside.story: P90: InP doubling lands a quarter early again (PhotonCap), the Marvell DSP and 200G EML bottlenecks that held back 2026 1.6T shipments clear (cnyes), Innolight-style 2027 order acceleration flows to COHR lasers and modules, CPO laser-source volume from the NVIDIA commitment adds on top; capture +18%, D&C margin +2pt on 6-inch cost (4x devices at half the cost per device); customers dual-source away from a Marvell-owned Lumentum (appraisal high variant); P/E re-rates 6 turns to 26x, near the peer median plus growth premium.

Model EBIT and EPS are company non-GAAP (ex SBC); SBC is counted once through the share count: diluted shares 202.2 grow +1%/yr, which covers SBC dilution (FY27 SBC ~272 at ~$210 = ~1.3M shares, ~0.6%) with no buybacks; FCF is not reduced by SBC (sbc_treatment dilution). Peers' NTM P/Es are on Nasdaq/Zacks consensus, mostly non-GAAP ex SBC; COHR's own multiple is measured on the company basis (Zacks row + ~0.97 basis gap).

reasoning: Started from the thread's quarterly driver set and tested each driver against non-traditional evidence. dc_capture (kept): channel checks say 2026 1.6T shipments fell short on Marvell DSP quality and 200G EML supply, not demand (cnyes expert), Innolight says 2027 orders still accelerate, PhotonCap reports InP doubling a quarter ahead and InP as the binding constraint, TrendForce sees EML lead times beyond 2027; against that LightCounting calls the chain overreacting and flags a 2027-30 correction. That is two-sided, so the set's capture path stays and the range goes into the scenarios. dc_margin: trimmed 25-50bp in FY28-29 on expected 1.6T price declines and new entrants; 6-inch InP cost (4x devices at ~half the cost) caps the cut. Capex raised to 16/12/10% because Q4 FY26 capex ran $556M (~27% of revenue). ind_rev / ind_margin kept. SBC moved to dilution so the P/E on non-GAAP EPS counts it once. Valuation: one NTM P/E leg, peer median 25.25x of six genuine whole-company optics/connectivity peers (LITE/MRVL deal-pegged, ALAB unlike, China names excluded), own 18.9x on company basis, k = 0.8 exit 20.0x; plus the appraisal's share shift after the NTM window at p 0.75 (+$6.2). Base $285 (+36%); downside $133 and upside $467 are driver plus 6-turn multiple cases sized to 1-in-10 outcomes against an 89% realized vol and a 57x-to-25x forward P/E swing this year. Guidance: Q1 revenue inside the range near the top (record +3.3%), EPS just above the top (record +7.4%). Alt-data signals: short interest down 18% to 4.6% of float, hedge-fund holders down 114 to 105, hiring signal flat (+7% open roles in 30 days, low-confidence vendor data). Limits: X/Twitter not fetched directly (Serenity's view via an Odaily summary), Seeking Alpha blocked, Counterpoint FCC article body not readable, no prediction market on the deal or the name was found; Benzinga's options-sentiment readings were seen in passing and not used. In-lane share: 10 of 25 sources (10 of 18 excluding the company's own filings and releases) are lane-type; at least 4 (cnyes expert, PhotonCap, Autobound, primarysourced) are unlikely to be found by other lanes.

downside.story: P10: LightCounting's 'bumpy ride' correction arrives in CY2027-28 (it already calls the supply chain 'clearly overreacting' and assumes only +50% capex in 2027) while new module capacity (Innolight, Eoptolink, later Luxshare/Dongshan) and CPO/NPO pilots cut pluggable pricing: D&C capture -25% (FY28 D&C ~9.0B instead of 12.0B), D&C margin -3pt (back to ~24%, below FY26 25.2% on under-absorbed 6-inch InP capacity), Industrial -10% and -2pt on a semicap turn; the P/E de-rates 6 turns to 14x as the market prices a cyclical peak and the cash burn (FY26 FCF -1.02B, five OCF misses) persists. Marvell bundle takes COHR transceiver share (appraisal low variant).

upside.story: P90: InP doubling lands a quarter early again (PhotonCap), the Marvell DSP and 200G EML bottlenecks that held back 2026 1.6T shipments clear (cnyes), Innolight-style 2027 order acceleration flows to COHR lasers and modules, CPO laser-source volume from the NVIDIA commitment adds on top; capture +18%, D&C margin +2pt on 6-inch cost (4x devices at half the cost per device); customers dual-source away from a Marvell-owned Lumentum (appraisal high variant); P/E re-rates 6 turns to 26x, near the peer median plus growth premium.

comps_summary.peer_count_flag: 6 whole-company peers (FN, AAOI, CRDO, CIEN, GLW, MTSI) + 3 Industrial segment-only (IPGP, MKSI, NOVT; ~17% of FY27 revenue). Excluded: LITE and MRVL (prices now pegged to the 4.5 MRVL per LITE deal), ALAB (PCIe/CXL retimer fabless, ~75% gross margin, no optics), Innolight/Eoptolink (China-domiciled, structural discount). No other listed merchant laser + transceiver maker of COHR's scale; not padded.

model_inputs.structure_note: Thread quarterly driver set (Q1 FY2026-Q4 FY2029, base FY2026, actual 4) kept for dc_capture, ind_rev, ind_margin and the corp / lite_shift constants; agent_4 changes dc_margin FY28-29 (27.25/27.0% vs 27.5%), capex (16/12/10% vs 12/10/9%) and SBC treatment (dilution, share count +1%/yr). Value carried by one NTM P/E leg at 20.0x (k = 0.8 shrink from own 18.9x toward the 25.25x peer median) on model non-GAAP EPS at 2027-11-03, plus a probability-weighted adjustment for the Marvell-Lumentum share shift after the NTM window. No DCF (not a neocloud). Driven share of revenue 100%.

horizon_multiples.peer_basis: Whole-company optics/AI-connectivity peers FN 18.9x, AAOI 19.7x, CRDO 22.1x, CIEN 28.4x, GLW 29.5x, MTSI 32.4x NTM P/E (peers.md, Nasdaq/Zacks consensus): median 25.25x. COHR own NTM on company non-GAAP basis 210.41 / 11.13 = 18.9x (Zacks-basis NTM 10.16 = 8/12 x 8.71 + 4/12 x 13.07, plus ~0.97 Zacks-to-company gap). Exit = 25.25 x (18.9/25.25)^0.8 = 20.0x, applied to model NTM non-GAAP EPS (ex SBC, ex amortization), SBC carried as share dilution.

adjustments.name: Marvell-Lumentum share shift after the horizon NTM (FY2030 ramp to run-rate, if close)
adjustments.note: Appraisal base run-rate op income +136/yr if close (share_shift.md); after tax 136 x 0.81 = 110.2; NTM at the horizon holds ~0 (lite_shift_rev starts Q1 FY29: 5.6 x 44.2% = 2.5 pre-tax); capitalised at the 20.0x exit P/E = 2,204, discounted 2.5 years (run-rate CY2030Q3) at ~11% cost of equity: 2,204 / 1.11^2.5 = 1,697; x p_close 0.75 = 1,273 (~$6.2/share). Low/high variants (-84 / +705 run-rate op income) are carried in the scenario stories.

model_inputs.gap_note: fair_value.value equals the engine base. Judgment calls for Kilian: (1) peers' consensus basis vs COHR's Zacks basis (SBC) moves the exit multiple between ~19.3x and 20.0x (~3.5%); (2) capex path has no company guide; (3) LITE share-shift adjustment uses the appraisal's base; no source quantifies a precedent share move. Financing: no equity raise or convert with >=20% probability found; FY26 FCF -1.02B was funded by the NVIDIA $2B placement and cash (net debt 1,235), and the build turns FCF positive in FY28, so no financing_events booked (probability of a raise by the horizon ~10%, judgment). Q1 FY27 prints 2026-11-04 after the close: the set should be updated after it.
